summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Magnum Ice Cream Co N.V., a foreign private issuer, disclosing routine share acquisitions by PDMRs (President Asia and Chief Corporate Affairs Sustainability Officer) under the EU/UK Market Abuse Regulation. The filing reports open-market purchases of ordinary shares at ~$15.99 on the NYSE and €13.90 on Amsterdam Exchange. No transaction terms (stake %, premium, or dates) beyond the details provided. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are mentioned. This is a standard compliance disclosure of insider trading, not a special situation.
